text:
Jules (Recruiter): Heads-up  two interviewers told me their scorecards submitted but the ATS shows blank comments for CAND-10021 and CAND-10027. Anyone seeing backend rejects?

Ava (People Ops): Can you confirm if they used the mobile UI? We recently shipped a compact mobile form.

Jules (Recruiter): Yes one used mobile, one desktop. Both saw a green success toast. No error on front end.

Ben (Platform): webhook-bot shows a 202 from client but our ingest wrote null for 'free_text'. Snippet: POST /ingest/scorecard 202 
body:{"free_text":"Great problem solver","ctx":{"ui_variant":"compact-mobile"}} -> stored.free_text=null

Rory (Hiring Manager): We need those qualitative notes for debriefs. Whats the rollback plan?

Ben (Platform): Short-term: mapper will accept both free_text and free_text_alt for 48h and well replay recent logs. Long-term: add schema header to requests and fail fast on mismatch. I'll open PLAT-3321.

Ava (People Ops): Please also add a short line to the interviewer checklist: "copy qualitative notes before closing tab on mobile" until this is resolved.

Jules (Recruiter): I'll DM the interviewers asking for their copies and hold decisions for these two candidates until replay. Thanks.

webhook-bot: PLAT-3321 created by Ben: "scorecard mapper: tolerate compact-mobile payloads"
